target.title: fix(openrouter): apply request policy to music generation requests
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users generating music through OpenRouter could configure provider request policy, such as custom headers or proxy settings, but the OpenRouter music generation HTTP request ignored that policy.

## Why This Change Was Made

The OpenRouter music provider now sanitizes `cfg.models.providers.openrouter.request` and passes it into the existing provider HTTP resolver for the music generation request path. The change stays limited to music generation request configuration and leaves model selection, streaming, timeout, and response parsing behavior unchanged.

## User Impact

Users who rely on provider-level request settings can expect OpenRouter music generation to honor the same configured transport policy as the other OpenRouter media path. Default behavior is unchanged when no request policy is configured.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/openrouter/music-generation-provider.test.ts` passed: 14 tests.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --engine claude --model claude-fable-5 --thinking high` reported no accepted/actionable findings.

### 2026-07-12 follow-up: exact-head local provider-path proof

- Exact PR head verified locally: `cfa01f26006397c224945e634965d354d1803792`.
- Command: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/openrouter/music-generation-provider.test.ts`.
- Result: passed 1 Vitest shard in 52.57s; 14 tests passed.
- The focused regression covers the changed OpenRouter music generation request path and verifies the configured provider request policy is passed into the HTTP resolver for music generation.
- This is controlled local provider-path proof only. No live OpenRouter API call was made, and no real OpenRouter account, proxy, or generated music artifact was exercised.

## Proof

### 2026-07-12 exact-head local transport proof after latest update-branch

- Exact head tested after normal `gh pr update-branch`: `db61b220c6fb16892f0b9728a1de2921ca875655`.
- Scope: controlled local provider-path proof for OpenRouter music generation. This is not a live OpenRouter API call.
- Commands run:

  ```bash
  git fetch fork alix/openrouter-request-policy-music-generation --no-tags
  git checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
  git rev-parse HEAD
  git diff --check
  node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/openrouter/music-generation-provider.ts extensions/openrouter/music-generation-provider.test.ts extensions/openrouter/music-generation-provider.transport.test.ts
  node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/openrouter/music-generation-provider.transport.test.ts extensions/openrouter/music-generation-provider.test.ts
  ```

- Result: PASS. `git diff --check` passed; focused oxlint exited 0; Vitest passed 1 shard, 2 files, 15 tests in 89.61s total wall time. Vitest duration: 63.81s.
- Transcript excerpt:

  ```text
  HEAD is now at db61b220c6 Merge branch 'main' into alix/openrouter-request-policy-music-generation
  db61b220c6fb16892f0b9728a1de2921ca875655
  Test Files  2 passed (2)
  Tests  15 passed (15)
  [test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 89.61s
  ```

- Observation: `extensions/openrouter/music-generation-provider.transport.test.ts` starts a local HTTP server, calls `buildOpenRouterMusicGenerationProvider().generateMusic(...)`, leaves the SDK provider HTTP module unmocked, enables `allowPrivateNetwork: true`, and verifies the configured `X-OpenRouter-Trace` request header reaches `/api/v1/chat/completions` while the streamed SSE audio response is decoded into a track. The companion provider test keeps the existing request-policy wiring coverage.
- Not tested: no live OpenRouter account, real API key, external proxy/TLS route, or external provider music endpoint was exercised.
